reviewDecisions.rationale: Mechanical 0.84 capacity reset plus mine-level implementation and official price turn is a direct economic state change worth deep research.
Formal annual build scale and quality mix change the project pipeline, but company-level profitable conversion still needs verification.
Qualification can redistribute addressable demand; deep research must quantify actual order/share effects and subsidy/cash risks.
Specialist evidence shows demand recovery and tightening; A-share mapping must fail closed if only thematic proxies exist.
Supplier behavior changed before confirmed contract-price reversal; keep as early-turn research requiring direct mapping and confirmation.
Shipment, inventory and price evidence form a measurable cycle turn with potential direct panel-company earnings transmission.
Quote hikes and stop-quote behavior are economically meaningful, but independent verification and duration are mandatory.
Repeated price hikes and direct issuer disclosure merit research, while continuation status and loss guidance block any automatic fresh escalation.
Large reported procurement with supplier shares is a new order event; original-source verification and materiality are required.
A discrete infrastructure award can create company orders, but secondary provenance and fragmented competition require strict verification.
Broad high-tech/equipment acceleration lacks a sufficiently narrow causal event and direct company transmission; retained as a negative control.
